name: 48030 · Hazel Park, MI
findings: ZIP 48030 (Hazel Park) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (86% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48030 (Hazel Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48030 (Hazel Park) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
